checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Using the same pre-action observation for the deterministic anchor, compare FK of decoded IK joints with the demonstrated commanded TCP target in metres/radians and compare the unchanged gripper scalar. Rotation 6D is deterministically projected to SO(3); unconverged IK is returned with explicit diagnostics rather than replaced.

contract.cut_relation: Uses every assigned action in [900,1330) for all 12 trajectories. The complete [900,1160) action-supervised overlap with place_block_in_drawer is preserved; only causal coordinates and the Cartesian action reference frame are changed.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [adaptive-anchor xyz metres, adaptive-anchor relative rotation 6D, native gripper scalar]. The anchor orientation is target_pose orientation. Its world translation is p_target + g*(p_object-p_target), where g=clip((drawer_position-0.24)/0.04,0,1)*clip((0.16-||p_tcp-p_object||)/0.08,0,1). Labels use the corresponding slot's pre-action observation; decoding recomputes the anchor from the fresh current observation. The 6D pair is projected by Gram-Schmidt to SO(3), composed with the anchor to a world TCP target, and passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8 beginning at current t.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level arguments. target_pose and object_pose are observed world poses in metres with wxyz quaternions, and drawer_position is metres. The executor supplies two causal observations and a fresh observation for each decoded slot. The adaptive interaction anchor is recomputed from those observations identically in training and deployment.
